description:
Advances: ancora.scaffold

Stage: L12 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
mix spec.init (--root, --force; writes AGENTS.md, agents/SKILL.md, README.md, config.yml, decisions/README.md, one seed subject; wrote/kept per file; no workflow template), mix spec.decision.new (DECISION_ID, --title, --force; id/status/date/affects plus three sections, no change_type), and the rewritten priv/spec_init/ templates against the content specs in ancora.scaffold.agents_md_content, skill_md_content, config_template. Ancora README completed: stable public API section (exactly Ancora.Parser.parse_file/2 and Ancora.DecisionParser.parse_file/2), --root as internal affordance, introspection-posture paragraph in plain words, mix format --migrate expect-acknowledgment note, six-line CI job snippet, positioning language never proof. docs/migration.md with the common migration checklist and the old-to-new code map (Appendix A of 03-architecture corrected to the 30-code registry).

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.scaffold.init_writes_templates, agents_md_content, skill_md_content, config_template, no_retired_vocabulary, fresh_adopter_round_trip, decision_new, readme_commitments, migration_doc
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.scaffold.scenario.init_in_tmp_repo, init_keeps_then_forces, agents_needles (read-protocol needle quoted via Ancora.Output.read_protocol/0 so template and test cannot drift), skill_triage_table (every registry code appears once), config_template_loads, retired_vocabulary_absent (needles from one shared retired-vocabulary list sourced from the migration map), fresh_adopter_journey (init into tmp git repo, in-process spec.check --base HEAD: unanchored warnings, result=fail tier=branch; tag one test, pass), decision_new_shape, readme_needles, migration_map_complete
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.check --base HEAD; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: fresh adopters run spec.init; consumer migration PRs (M6-M9) author AGENTS.md from the template; proving test is the round-trip
  - Fixture hygiene: tmp git repos at runtime; nothing compiled
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (wrote/kept/--force; each template needle)
- Call-site Integration: production callers are mix spec.init in a fresh repo and the M4 skill rewrites that read these content specs; proving tests are the needle suite and the fresh-adopter round-trip.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/{gate,derive,output,review,prime,next,status}* (read-only here)
- lib/mix/tasks/spec.{check,validate,prime,next,status,review}.ex
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/mix/tasks/spec.init.ex, lib/mix/tasks/spec.decision.new.ex, lib/ancora/init.ex
- priv/spec_init/**
- README.md, docs/migration.md
- test/mix/tasks/spec_{init,decision_new}_test.exs, test/ancora/scaffold/**, test/support/retired_vocabulary.ex, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.scaffold.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no GitHub workflow template; no trailer-fork or state.json content in any template
- no proof or verified-behavior language anywhere
- no retired vocabulary (execute:, realized_by:, --no-run-commands, old codes, Spec-Drift:, SPECLED_*)

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base HEAD emits a verdict line
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: L12: Scaffolds and docs (spec.init, decision.new, README, migration checklist)
